name: AfriDirect Payment
author: afrirates

sections.description:
AfriDirect Payment lets your customers pay you directly, by bank transfer, Zelle, PayPal, Venmo, Cash App, Wise, Payoneer, Skrill, mobile money, cryptocurrency or any custom method, and then upload proof of payment. You review the proof and approve it. Use it at WooCommerce checkout or on standalone payment forms for services and donations.

Key Features

  • Multiple Payment Methods: Support for bank transfers, Zelle, PayPal, Venmo, Cash App, Wise, Payoneer, Skrill, mobile money, cryptocurrency, and custom payment methods
  • Payment Forms Builder: Create unlimited payment forms with different method combinations
  • Payment Methods Library: Reusable payment method profiles with rich instructions, QR codes, and copy-to-clipboard fields
  • Proof Upload System: Customers can upload payment proof (images or PDFs) with drag-and-drop interface
  • Custom Order Statuses: Track orders through pending payment, proof uploaded, approved, rejected, and expired statuses
  • Countdown Timer: Visual countdown showing payment deadline
  • Admin Dashboard: Payment totals by currency and period, plus a review queue for payment proofs with approve/reject functionality
  • Email Notifications: Customers are emailed at every step, and you are told when new proof needs review
  • Receipt Generation: Automatic receipt number generation with year-based counters
  • HPOS Compatible: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant with keyboard navigation and screen reader support
  • Mobile Responsive: Beautiful, mobile-first design

How It Works

  1. Customer selects AfriDirect Payment Plugin at checkout
  2. Customer chooses a payment method from available options
  3. Order is created with pending payment status and countdown timer
  4. Customer completes payment and uploads proof
  5. Admin reviews proof in dashboard
  6. Admin approves or rejects with notes
  7. Customer receives email notification and receipt (if approved)

Payment Methods Library

Create reusable payment method profiles with:
* Method type (bank, PayPal, Zelle, Venmo, Cash App, Wise, Payoneer, Skrill, mobile money, crypto, custom)
* Type-specific fields (account numbers, emails, wallet addresses, etc.)
* Rich text instructions
* Optional QR code images
* Copy-to-clipboard fields

Payment Forms Builder

Build unlimited payment forms by:
* Selecting which payment methods to include
* Setting default timer duration
* Drag-and-drop method ordering
* Per-method timer overrides

Security Features

  • Nonce verification on all forms
  • Capability checks for admin functions
  • Input sanitization and output escaping
  • Secure file upload validation
  • Access control for receipts

Development

Contributing

Contributions are welcome! Please ensure all code follows WordPress coding standards and includes proper security checks.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit the plugin support forum.

Credits

Built for businesses that take payments directly from customers and need proof of payment before they confirm an order.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “AfriDirect Payment Plugin”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the afridirect-payment folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments
  4. Enable “AfriDirect Payment Plugin” payment gateway
  5. Configure your payment methods and forms

Configuration

  1. Set Up Payment Methods:

    • Go to WooCommerce > AfriDirect Payment Plugin > AfriDirect Methods
    • Add payment methods (bank accounts, PayPal emails, etc.)
    • Configure instructions and optional QR codes

  2. Create Payment Forms:

    • Go to WooCommerce > AfriDirect Payment Plugin > AfriDirect Forms
    • Create forms and select which methods to include
    • Set timer durations and method order

  3. Configure Gateway:

    • Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > AfriDirect Payment Plugin
    • Select default payment form
    • Customize gateway title and description

  4. Review Orders:

    • Go to WooCommerce > AfriDirect Payment Plugin
    • Review uploaded proofs
    • Approve or reject orders with notes
sections.faq:
What payment methods are supported?

The plugin supports bank transfers, Zelle, PayPal, Venmo, Cash App, Wise, Payoneer, Skrill, mobile money, cryptocurrency, and custom payment methods. You can create unlimited payment method profiles.

Can I customize the payment instructions?

Yes! Each payment method supports rich text instructions, and you can include QR codes and copy-to-clipboard fields.

How long do customers have to upload proof?

You can set a default timer per payment form, and override it per payment method. The timer is displayed as a countdown on the order page.

What file types are accepted for proof upload?

Accepted formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP, PDF. Maximum file size: 5MB.

Is this plugin compatible with HPOS?

Yes! AfriDirect Payment Plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Can customers re-upload proof if rejected?

Yes, if an order is rejected, customers can upload a new proof file. The status will automatically update to “proof uploaded” for review.

Are emails customizable?

Yes, all emails use WooCommerce email templates and can be customized through WooCommerce > Settings > Emails.

What happens if payment deadline expires?

Orders automatically move to “expired” status, and customers receive an email notification. They can contact you to resolve the issue.

Is the plugin accessible?

Yes, the plugin follows WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines with keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and proper ARIA attributes.
sections.changelog:
1.5.0

  • New: you are emailed when a customer starts a payment and again when they upload proof, each with a link to review it. Turn either off or choose another address under Settings > Notifications.
  • New: standalone payments now email the customer when the form is submitted (with a link back to their payment page and deadline) and when their proof is received.
  • Fixed: approving a WooCommerce order sent the customer no email. The plugin’s own approval email, with the receipt link, is now sent.
  • Fixed: declining a WooCommerce order sent only WooCommerce’s generic “unsuccessful” email. Customers now get the plugin’s rejection email with your reason.
  • Improved: emails to WooCommerce customers link to the payment page that works without logging in, so guest customers can upload a new proof.
  • Improved: standalone approval and rejection emails include a receipt link and an upload-again link.

1.4.1

  • Fixed: uploading proof of payment on a standalone payment form failed with an error on sites without WooCommerce.
  • Fixed: Shop Managers could open Standalone Payments but could not approve or reject; this now follows the same permission as the plugin menu.
  • Improved: a customer with a valid order link can upload proof even when logged in as a different user.
  • Improved: uninstalling with data removal enabled now also clears unused draft payment forms.

1.4.0

  • New payments overview on the Dashboard: confirmed payments, pending confirmation and total payments.
  • Filter the overview by currency (amounts in different currencies are never added together or converted) and by period: all time, this month, last 30 days or last 7 days.
  • Works with WooCommerce orders and standalone payments, and without WooCommerce.

1.3.1

  • Clearer plugin description.

1.3.0

  • New payment method types: Venmo, Cash App, Wise, Payoneer, Skrill and Mobile Money (M-Pesa, MTN MoMo, Airtel Money and more).

1.2.2

  • Payment receipts now show your store name instead of a fixed plugin title.

1.2.1

  • Fixed: the Payment Methods page showed “You do not have sufficient permissions” on sites without WooCommerce.

1.2.0

  • New modern admin interface: branded header with tabs, a Dashboard with payment stats, a review queue and a setup checklist.
  • New Settings page with a toggle for checkout, default payment form and data-removal option.
  • Payment methods shown as cards; payments lists restyled with status pills and clear Approve/Decline buttons.
  • Responsive admin screens for tablets and phones.
  • Uninstall now also removes payment forms, payment records and plugin-created pages when “delete data on uninstall” is enabled.

1.1.2

  • Fixed the Settings link on the Plugins page for sites without WooCommerce (it showed “not allowed to access this page”).

1.1.1

  • Added author link to the plugin header.

1.1.0

  • First release on WordPress.org.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Payment methods library
  • Payment forms builder
  • Proof upload system
  • Custom order statuses
  • Admin dashboard
  • Email notifications
  • Receipt generation
  • HPOS compatibility
  • Accessibility improvements
  • Mobile-responsive design
